note: Read this index first and only 1-2 shortlisted profiles. No tool is valid; HOME_PREVIEW_MODE is native-only.

tools.name: Native Web Platform
tools.stack_fit: Framework-independent first choice; CSS, HTML, and browser APIs.
avoid_when: the mechanic requires complex synchronized orchestration that native primitives cannot maintain clearly
stop_rules: stop if browser support lacks a usable static or progressive fallback
tools.progressive_enhancement: Required; semantic static content is the baseline.
tools.reduced_motion: Provide a designed static state with prefers-reduced-motion.
tools.performance_client_boundary: Prefer CSS; isolate optional browser API code and measure production routes.

tools.name: Motion for React (core)
tools.stack_fit: Conditional React client-component runtime after native options are insufficient.
avoid_when: CSS or platform primitives are sufficient
Motion+ is not explicitly purchased and authorized
stop_rules: stop if the client boundary or runtime cost is unjustified
never overlap the same mechanic with GSAP
tools.progressive_enhancement: Render meaningful React/HTML content before animation.
tools.reduced_motion: Replace movement with an intentional static or low-motion composition.
tools.performance_client_boundary: Use the smallest explicit client boundary and measure production behavior.
tools.payment: Motion core payment requirements UNKNOWN; Motion+ is paid/proprietary and requires explicit purchase/authorization.

tools.name: View Transitions API
tools.stack_fit: Native progressive enhancement for simple same- or cross-document continuity.
avoid_when: there is no navigation continuity need
support constraints cannot retain instant navigation
stop_rules: stop if transitions delay or block navigation
tools.progressive_enhancement: Unsupported browsers navigate normally and immediately.
tools.reduced_motion: Disable or substantially simplify transition motion.
tools.performance_client_boundary: Use feature detection; measure navigation and rendering on target browsers.

tools.name: GSAP with ScrollTrigger
tools.stack_fit: Conditional React/client runtime for justified complex timelines or scroll orchestration.
avoid_when: native or Motion core is sufficient
stop_rules: never overlap the same mechanic with Motion
stop without static and reduced-motion fallbacks
tools.progressive_enhancement: Content and native scroll work before runtime initialization.
tools.reduced_motion: Remove scroll-linked movement and preserve a composed static flow.
tools.performance_client_boundary: Isolate registration and lifecycle to the owning client component; trace target-runtime work.

tools.name: Three.js / WebGL
tools.stack_fit: Spatial-only client runtime when 3D understanding is essential and a 2D fallback exists.
avoid_when: a photo or video communicates equally well
production 3D assets or maintenance budget are absent
stop_rules: stop without optimized assets, device strategy, and quality 2D fallback
tools.progressive_enhancement: Ship a high-quality static 2D render before WebGL activation.
tools.reduced_motion: Default to static 2D or user-controlled non-automatic movement.
tools.performance_client_boundary: Lazy/tap activate, cap device work, and profile production assets on target hardware.
